comments.body:
Switzerland is a Schengen country, so if you have a residency permit there you can visit other Schengen countries (most EU countries) and even live there temporarily (I think it was up to 90 days, but I might be wrong). So you can use your permit to go to job interviews, but afaik it doesn't allow you to work in other countries.

You need a residency permit of the other country to work there. How it works exactly depends on the country, but usually you get a work contract first and then apply for the permit before you start your job, or you might be allowed to start working while you wait for your permit to be issued. It depends on many factors, so you'd have to look it up for your specific situation.
